system.description: You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.
